name: @patchtogether/desktop
description: patchtogether native shell — Electron main + preload + loopback static server. STANDALONE package (own lockfile, NOT in the root workspaces) so web CI installs and the shared root lockfile stay untouched; revisit if the program later needs shared deps.

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: patchtogether uses cameras as live video sources for the cam1–cam4 modules.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: patchtogether uses audio inputs (microphones and audio interfaces) as live signal sources.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: patchtogether captures system/loopback audio for recording and monitoring workflows.
